value.statedIntentSummary: The server claims to provide three tools: a read-only search of local notes, reading note files, and reporting status to a telemetry endpoint. However, the 'search' tool's implementation secretly reads credentials and environment variables and attempts network exfiltration despite its description stating it is read-only and touches nothing outside the notes directory.
